title: Proteomics Workflow for Whole Cell Lysate, Endosome, and Lysosome Fractions
author: Hankum Park
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bys6pwhe
materials: Briefly dry pellets in a SpeedVac.
Pool TMT-labeled samples with 1:1 ratio and dry.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cell lines (293 or 293 stably expressing TMEM192-HA and FLAG-EEA1) in 15cm dishes. At ~80% confluency, harvest cells on ice by scraping in 2-3 mL DPBS.

substeps.instruction: Pellet cells at 1,000xg for 2 min at 4 ºC
Discard supernatant

steps.title: Prepare Whole Cell Lysates
steps.instruction: Wash cell pellets once with DPBS and resuspend in 8 M urea buffer supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Lyse by sonication
Centrifuge lysates at 17,000xg for 8 min at 4 ºC
Collect the supernatant

steps.title: Protein Quantification and Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Determine total protein concentration using a BCA assay and aliquot 50 μg of the proteins.

steps.title: Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Reduce and alkylate the protein samples.

substeps.instruction: Add TCEP to 5 mM final and incubate at 25 ºC for 30 min
Add iodoacetamide to 15 mM final and incubate at 25 ºC for 30 min, protected from light

steps.title: Protein Precipitation and Washing
steps.instruction: Precipitate and clean the protein samples.

substeps.instruction: Add EPPS buffer to dilute urea to 1 M final concentration
Add 6.1 N TCA solution to 20% final and incubate at 4 ºC for 1h
Centrifuge samples at 20,000xg for 7 min at 4 ºC and remove supernatants
Wash pellets twice with ice-cold acetone by centrifuging at 20,000xg for 10 min at 4 ºC

steps.title: Protein Resuspension and First Digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellets in 50 µL of 8 M urea buffer and sonicate in a water bath sonicator.

substeps.instruction: Dilute urea by adding 50 µL of 200 mM EPPS, pH 8.5
Digest peptides with 1 µg of LysC and incubate at 30 ºC for 4h with shaking
Further dilute urea to 1.6 M final by adding 200 mM EPPS

steps.title: Second Digestion
steps.instruction: Further digest peptides with 1 µg trypsin and incubate at 37 ºC overnight with shaking.

steps.title: TMT Labeling and Quenching
steps.instruction: Label the digested peptides using TMT or TMTpro reagents.

substeps.instruction: Add acetonitrile (ACN) to 30% final
Add 10 μL of TMT reagents (10 μg/μL in anhydrous ACN) or TMTpro reagents (12.5 μg/μL in anhydrous ACN) and incubate for 1h at 25 ºC
Quench labeling with hydroxylamine at 0.5% final and incubate at room temperature for 15 min

steps.title: Desalting and Sample Preparation
steps.instruction: Desalt the sample using C18 solid-phase extraction (Sep-Pak) and dry the eluate.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend samples in 110 µL of 10 mM ammonium bicarbonate, 5% ACN solution
Filter through a 0.2 µm PTFE centrifugal filter

steps.title: High-pH Reverse-Phase HPLC Pre-fractionation
steps.instruction: Pre-fractionate samples using an Agilent 1260 Infinity with an Aeris C18 column (250 mm 4.6 mm).

substeps.instruction: Use gradient of mobile phase A (10 mM ammonium bicarbonate, 5% ACN) and mobile phase B (10 mM ammonium bicarbonate, 90% ACN)
Collect 96 fractions between 10 min (10% B) and 72 min (100% B) at 0.6 mL/min
Concatenate into 24 fractions
Dry fractions by SpeedVac and desalt by C18 StageTip
Resuspend alternating 12 fractions (out of 24) in 3% ACN, 1% FA for LC-MS analysis

steps.title: LC-MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform LC-MS analysis using an Orbitrap Eclipse coupled with a Proxeon EASY-nLC1200 pump.

substeps.instruction: Separate peptides on a microcapillary column (100 μm inner diameter) packed with ~35 cm of Accucore150 resin (2.6 μm, 150 Å)
Apply ACN (0.1% FA) gradient: 8-23% (3-73 min), 23-30% (73-80 min), 30-100% (83-86 min) at 550 nL/min
Use multi-notch MS3-based TMT method with Real Time Search (REF) algorithm
MS1: Orbitrap (res 120,000 at 200 Th, 400-1500 m/z, AGC 2*10^5, max injection 50 ms), precursor fit filter 70% (0.5 Th window), dynamic exclusion (90 s, ± 10 ppm)
MS2: Quadrupole-ion trap CID (Rapid scan, AGC 1*10^4, isolation 0.5 Th, NBE 34, max injection 80 ms)
SPS API-MS3: Collect top 10 most intense b- or y-ions matched with REF
MS3: HCD fragmentation analyzed by Orbitrap (NCE 45, AGC 2.5*10^5, max injection 200 ms, res 50,000 at 200 Th)
Set closeout at two peptides per protein per fraction

steps.title: Data Processing and Protein Quantification
steps.instruction: Convert RAW files to mzXML and search against Swiss-Prot human database (with contaminants and reversed decoy).

substeps.instruction: Search parameters: 20-ppm precursor ion tolerance, 1.0005 Da product ion tolerance
Static modifications: carbamidomethylation at cysteine (+57.021 Da), TMT labeling at lysine (+229.162 Da for TMT or +304.207 Da for TMTpro)
Variable modifications: oxidation at methionine (+15.995 Da), TMT labeling at peptide N-termini (+229.162 Da for TMT or +304.207 Da for TMTpro)
Filter PSMs using linear discriminant analysis (XCorr, ΔCn, missed cleavages, peptide length, charge state, precursor mass accuracy) at 1% FDR
Protein assembly by parsimony principle at 1% FDR
Quantify by summing reporter ion counts (integration tolerance 0.003 Da) and adjust S/N using vendor isotopic impurity table

steps.title: Bioinformatic Analysis
steps.instruction: Export protein quantitation values to csv and analyze using R 3.6.3.

substeps.instruction: Normalize protein abundances according to total reporter values per channel
Calculate Pearson’s correlation coefficient using cor()
Classify subcellular locations using proteins annotated as 'very high' or 'high' from Itzhak et al (2016)

steps.title: Lysosomal and Endosomal Fraction Processing
steps.instruction: Purify lysosomal and endosomal fractions as per protocol dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byi9puh6 and process as follows:

substeps.instruction: Reduce with TCEP at 5 mM final (25 ºC, 30 min)
Alkylate with iodoacetamide at 15 mM final (25 ºC, 30 min, protect from light)
Dilute with EPPS buffer to 1 M urea final concentration
Precipitate with 6.1 N TCA solution to 20% final (4 ºC, 1h)
Centrifuge at 20,000xg for 15 min at 4 ºC and remove supernatants
Wash twice with ice-cold acetone (20,000xg, 10 min, 4 ºC)
Briefly dry pellets in a SpeedVac
Resuspend pellets in 5 µL of 8 M urea buffer, sonicate in water bath, and dilute with 5 µL of 200 mM EPPS
Digest with 0.2 µg LysC (30 ºC, 4h, shaking), then dilute urea to 1.6 M final with 200 mM EPPS
Further digest with 0.2 µg trypsin (37 ºC, overnight, shaking)

steps.title: TMTpro Labeling and Fractionation (Organelles)
steps.instruction: Label the organelle-derived peptides and pre-fractionate.

substeps.instruction: Add ACN to 30% final
Label with 10 μL TMTpro reagents (12.5 μg/μL in anhydrous ACN) for 1h at 25 ºC
Quench with hydroxylamine to 0.5% final (room temperature, 15 min)
Pool sample, dry by SpeedVac, and pre-fractionate using Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit
Concatenate gradient eluates to four final fractions and desalt with C18 StageTip

steps.title: LC-MS Analysis (Organelles)
steps.instruction: Perform LC-MS using an Orbitrap Eclipse tribrid mass spectrometer and Proxeon EASY-nLC1200 pump.

substeps.instruction: Separate peptides on a microcapillary column (100 μm inner diameter) with ~35 cm Accucore150 resin (2.6 μm, 150 Å)
Apply ACN (0.1% FA) gradient: 5-30% (3-108 min), 30-99% (108-113 min) at 550 nL/min
Use FAIMS Pro Interface and multi-notch MS3-based TMT method with Real Time Search algorithm
MS1: Orbitrap (res 120,000 at 200 Th, 400-1500 m/z, AGC 4*10^5, max injection 50 ms), precursor fit filter 70% (0.5 Th window), dynamic exclusion (120 s, ± 7 ppm)
Select precursor ions: cycle type 1.25 sec/CV with FAIMS CV of -40/60/80
MS2: Quadrupole-ion trap CID (Rapid scan, AGC 1*10^4, isolation 0.5 Th, NBE 34, max injection 86 ms)
SPS API-MS3: Collect top 10 most intense b- or y-ions matched with real time search
MS3: HCD fragmentation analyzed by Orbitrap (NCE 45, AGC 2.5*10^5, max injection 200 ms, res 50,000 at 200 Th)
Set closeout at two peptides per protein per fraction

steps.title: Data Processing and Statistical Analysis (Organelles)
steps.instruction: Convert RAW files to mzXML and perform database searching and quantification as described for whole cell lysates.

substeps.instruction: Export protein quantitation values to csv and analyze by R 3.6.3
Perform two-sided Student’s t-test using t_test() in rstatix package v0.7.0
Adjust p-values using mt.rawp2adjp() with two-stage Benjamini & Hochberg (2006) step-up FDR-controlling procedure in multtest package v2.42.0
